title: ampelocissus jacquemontii
intro: Ampelocissus jacquemontii, commonly known as Jacquemont's Grape or Indian Grape, is a perennial climber native to the Himalayas. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions like wounds, infections, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents present in Ampelocissus jacquemontii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
